snippet.title: Playthrough of The Quest for Game Jam! / Luduvo
snippet.description:
Alpha Testers can play now however Game will be available for New Players on Q3 2026: https://luduvo.com/games/118

Hi! Today we are playing Me, Komplik & Temp Game Jam Entry we submitted for Luduvo 2026 Alpha Jam to show you guys and girls what the Game is about as a full playthrough for those who dont want to wait till release. This contains spoilers so do be aware!
